```{r libraries}
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(estimatr)  # for robust standard errors in weighted regression
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

# Subject labels for display
subject_labels <- c("ELA" = "English", "MATH" = "Math", "SCI" = "Science")
```

```{r load-data}
# Connect to SQLite database
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "../../data/processed/mcas.db")

# Read MCAS data
query <- "
  SELECT 
    DIST_NAME as district,
    year,
    SUBJECT_CODE as subject,
    AVG(avg_sgp) as avg_sgp,
    SUM(n_white) as total_n_white,
    SUM(n) as total_n,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(n) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(n_white) AS FLOAT) / SUM(n)
      ELSE NULL 
    END as prop_white
  FROM mcas 
  WHERE SUBSTR(ORG_CODE, -4) = '0000' 
    AND avg_sgp IS NOT NULL
    AND n > 0
    AND n_white IS NOT NULL
    AND DIST_NAME != 'State'
  GROUP BY DIST_NAME, year, SUBJECT_CODE
  HAVING SUM(n) > 100
  ORDER BY district, year, subject
"

mcas_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query)
dbDisconnect(con)

# Filter out null values and ensure reasonable bounds
mcas_data <- mcas_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(avg_sgp),
    !is.na(prop_white),
    prop_white >= 0,
    prop_white <= 1
  )

# cat("Data loaded:", nrow(mcas_data), "observations\n")
# cat("Years:", min(mcas_data$year), "-", max(mcas_data$year), "\n")
# cat("Districts:", length(unique(mcas_data$district)), "\n")
# cat("Subjects:", paste(unique(mcas_data$subject), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r regression-analysis}
# Function to run weighted regression with robust standard errors
run_weighted_regression <- function(data) {
  if (nrow(data) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  # Calculate normalized weights
  normalized_weights <- data$total_n / sum(data$total_n) * nrow(data)
  
  # Use estimatr::lm_robust for weighted regression with robust standard errors
  model <- lm_robust(avg_sgp ~ prop_white, 
                     data = data, 
                     weights = total_n,
                     se_type = "stata")

  # Extract coefficients
  coefs <- tidy(model)
  slope_row <- coefs[coefs$term == "prop_white", ]
  
  return(data.frame(
    slope = slope_row$estimate,
    std_error = slope_row$std.error,
    t_stat = slope_row$statistic,
    p_value = slope_row$p.value,
    conf_low = slope_row$conf.low,
    conf_high = slope_row$conf.high,
    n_districts = nrow(data),
    total_students = sum(data$total_n)
  ))
}

# Run regressions for each year-subject combination
regression_results <- mcas_data %>%
  group_by(year, subject) %>%
  do(run_weighted_regression(.)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  mutate(
    subject_label = recode(subject, !!!subject_labels),
    significant = p_value < 0.05
  )

# cat("Regression results for", nrow(regression_results), "year-subject combinations\n")
```


```{r main-plot, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=9}
# Create the main scatter plot with facets
p1 <- ggplot(mcas_data, aes(x = prop_white, y = avg_sgp)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total_n), alpha = 0.6, color = "#2563eb") +
  geom_smooth(aes(weight = total_n), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#dc2626", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "#666666", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(year ~ subject, labeller = labeller(subject = subject_labels)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), name = "Proportion White") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Average Student Growth Percentile") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of Students", 
                       range = c(0.01, 2),
                       labels = comma_format()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Student Growth vs. Proportion White by Year and Subject",
    subtitle = "Each point represents a school district, sized by number of students.\nRed lines show weighted regression trends."
  )

print(p1)

# Save as PNG for email
ggsave("student_growth_by_demographics.png", plot = p1, 
       width = 6.5, height = 9, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

```{r slope-trends, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4}
# Plot slope estimates over time by subject with facet grid and error bars
p2 <- regression_results %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = slope)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high), 
                width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, color = "#2563eb") +
  geom_point(color = "#2563eb", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(. ~ subject_label) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Regression Slope Estimates Over Time by Subject",
    subtitle = "Change in student growth percentile per unit increase in proportion white students\nError bars show 95% confidence intervals",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Slope Estimate",
    caption = "Districts weighted by student enrollment. Separate regressions for each year-subject combination."
  )

print(p2)

# Save as PNG for email  
ggsave("slope_trends_by_subject.png", plot = p2,
       width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
